questions.nlq: Hey! Could you help me list each company's location together with the average age of its employees who have been working there for more than a year, but only for companies that have at least three such employees? I'd love to see the ranking too.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say location, I mean the city or country where the company's main office is located.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH avg_emp AS (
    SELECT e.Company_ID,
           AVG(p.Age) AS avg_age,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM employment e
    JOIN people p ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
    WHERE e.Year_working > 1
    GROUP BY e.Company_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT c."Headquarters" AS location,
       a.avg_age,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_age DESC) AS rank
FROM avg_emp a
JOIN company c ON a.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
ORDER BY a.avg_age DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say location, I mean the country a person comes from, i.e., their nationality.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT
    p."Nationality" AS location,
    AVG(p."Age") AS avg_age,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(p."Age") DESC) AS rank
FROM "employment" e
JOIN "people" p ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
WHERE e."Year_working" > 1
GROUP BY e."Company_ID", p."Nationality"
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY rank;

    GROUP BY p.People_ID, p.Name

GROUP BY p.People_ID
ORDER BY SUM(e.Year_working) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH total_years AS (
    SELECT p."Name", SUM(e."Year_working") AS total_years
    FROM "people" p
    JOIN "employment" e ON p."People_ID" = e."People_ID"
    GROUP BY p."Name"
)
SELECT "Name"
FROM total_years
WHERE total_years = (SELECT MAX(total_years) FROM total_years);

WITH total_years_per_company AS (
    SELECT "Company_ID", SUM("Year_working") AS total_years
    FROM "employment"
    GROUP BY "Company_ID"
)
SELECT c."Name"
FROM total_years_per_company t
JOIN "company" c ON c."Company_ID" = t."Company_ID"
WHERE t.total_years = (
    SELECT MAX(total_years) FROM total_years_per_company
);
SELECT c.Name FROM "company" c JOIN "employment" e ON c."Company_ID" = e."Company_ID" GROUP BY c."Company_ID" ORDER BY SUM(e."Year_working") DESC LIMIT 1

WITH company_totals AS (
    SELECT "company"."Name", SUM("employment"."Year_working") AS total_years
    FROM "employment"
    JOIN "company" ON "employment"."Company_ID" = "company"."Company_ID"
    GROUP BY "company"."Name"
)
SELECT "Name"
FROM company_totals
WHERE total_years = (SELECT MAX(total_years) FROM company_totals);

Can you help me dig out the **names** of the major participants in the 'Oil and gas' industry who are holding onto workers for at least 5 years? 🤔 Just give me the ones that are sitting in the upper 50% when you line 'em up by their total sales figures AND also have more folks on payroll than the average crowd. 📈 Need this ranked properly!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term 'names' specifically refers to the official legal titles of the corporate organizations conducting business.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH oil_gas AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Company_ID,
        c.Name,
        c.Sales_in_Billion
    FROM company c
    WHERE c.Industry = 'Oil and gas'
),
with_5year_workers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eo.Company_ID
    FROM employment eo
    WHERE eo.Year_working >= 5
),
company_emp_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.Company_ID,
        COUNT(DISTINCT eg.People_ID) as emp_count
    FROM employment eg
    INNER JOIN with_5year_workers w5 ON eg.Company_ID = w5.Company_ID
    GROUP BY eg.Company_ID
),
avg_emp AS (
    SELECT AVG(emp_count) as avg_count
    FROM company_emp_counts
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        og.Name,
        og.Sales_in_Billion,
        ec.emp_count,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY og.Sales_in_Billion ASC) as sales_percentile
    FROM oil_gas og
    INNER JOIN company_emp_counts ec ON og.Company_ID = ec.Company_ID
    WHERE ec.Company_ID IN (SELECT Company_ID FROM with_5year_workers)
)
SELECT Name
FROM ranked
WHERE sales_percentile >= 0.5
AND emp_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_emp)
ORDER BY Sales_in_Billion DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The term 'names' specifically refers to the full legal names of the individual human beings who are employed by the organizations.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH oil_gas_companies AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Company_ID,
        c.Sales_in_Billion,
        COUNT(e.People_ID) as emp_count
    FROM company c
    JOIN employment e ON e.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
    WHERE c.Industry = 'Oil and gas'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM employment e2 
        WHERE e2.Company_ID = c.Company_ID 
        AND e2.Year_working >= 5
    )
    GROUP BY c.Company_ID, c.Sales_in_Billion
),
company_rankings AS (
    SELECT 
        Company_ID,
        emp_count,
        Sales_in_Billion,
        CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Sales_in_Billion DESC) AS REAL) / CAST(COUNT(*) OVER () AS REAL) as sales_percentile
    FROM oil_gas_companies
),
avg_emp AS (
    SELECT AVG(emp_count) as avg_count FROM company_rankings
),
top_companies AS (
    SELECT cr.Company_ID
    FROM company_rankings cr
    CROSS JOIN avg_emp ae
    WHERE cr.sales_percentile < 0.5
    AND cr.emp_count > ae.avg_count
)
SELECT p.Name
FROM employment e
JOIN people p ON e.People_ID = p.People_ID
WHERE e.Company_ID IN (SELECT Company_ID FROM top_companies)
ORDER BY e.Company_ID
